Privacy Policy

Last Updated: September 2026

1. Information We Collect

We collect information necessary to fulfill your orders, including your name, shipping address, email address, and phone number. Payment details are encrypted and securely processed by our PCI-compliant payment merchant.

2. How We Protect Your Data

We maintain strict administrative, physical, and technical safeguards. All transactional communications utilize 256-bit Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption protocols.

3. Non-Disclosure to Third Parties

We do not sell, rent, or lease customer contact information to third-party marketing companies. Your information is used exclusively for order fulfillment and customer support.

4. Your Rights

You have the right to request access to your stored personal data, request correction of inaccurate data, or request deletion of your information in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.
